_what: All-time executive-order totals per president, for the EO card's every-president context bars (register v3 #27, view kit).
_source: Verified 12 Aug 2026. FDR-Biden: National Archives Executive Orders Disposition Tables index (archives.gov/federal-register/executive-orders/disposition - EO number ranges; counts computed range-end minus range-start plus 1) cross-checked against federalregister.gov/presidential-documents/executive-orders displayed totals. Consistency check passed: Trump first term = 220 by both routes. Pre-FDR: American Presidency Project, UCSB (presidency.ucsb.edu/statistics/data/executive-orders) - labelled as UCSB-sourced on the card.
_flags: Obama: federalregister.gov displays 277 but its own 2009 row shows a 39-number range as 40 orders (one document double-counted); NARA's range (13489-13764) and UCSB both give 276 - we publish 276. Convention: FDR-era counts here are NUMBERED orders from NARA ranges; UCSB's pre-1945 figures include unnumbered orders (their FDR total is 3,726) - the card states the numbered-orders convention.
